overview: Hash table simulation (open addressing, linear probing, chaining), load factor, collision probability, hash function quality.
coreConcept: Load factor = n/m. Linear probing me collision par next slot (wrap-around).
hinglishExplanation: Keys ko diye gaye order me insert karo aur hash function se slot nikalo. Collision par linear probing me (h+i) mod m. Chaining me same slot ki list me jodo. Final table ya chain length poochhi jaati hai.
formalDefinition: Load factor = n/m. Linear probing me collision par next slot (wrap-around).
importantProperties: Linear probing: (h(k)+i) mod m; primary clustering.
Chaining ka fayda: deletion aur load factor > 1 possible.
Uniform hash function distribute better (m prime / uses all bits).
commonPitfalls: Deleted slots ka probing me role.
standardTechniques: Table draw karo, step by step insert.
